description: The one Honeycrisp window. Through the folder plugin the page opens the data folder Rust names at startup, by name (openFolder from @epicenter/folder), ~/Epicenter/honeycrisp, which its bundle identifier names and which the first open makes when nothing is there. The page holds no path but the one it shows. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may read an open root's identity and the record Epicenter keeps for the data folder, to show what is synced; the app never syncs (ADR-0822).
